captions.detailed: A floor-standing drafting table featuring a sturdy, black-painted metal support frame and an adjustable wooden tabletop. The base frame is constructed of tubular steel with rectangular feet and cross-braces for stability. The tabletop is light brown with a pencil ledge at the bottom edge. It is hinged at the front with cylindrical metallic pins, allowing it to tilt upward to various angles.
captions.instruction: Create a floor-standing drafting table with a black tubular metal frame and a tilting wooden tabletop. The tabletop should include a lip at the bottom edge and be connected to the frame via a revolute joint near the front edge to allow angle adjustment.
captions.factory: The code constructs a two-part articulated assembly. First, the base frame is built using rectangular boxes and cylindrical tubes for the legs, cross-braces, and feet, all colored black. Second, the tabletop is created as a flat wooden-colored box with an added front lip (pencil ledge) and cylindrical hinge pins. Finally, a revolute joint is defined at the front hinge axis to connect the tabletop to the base frame, enabling tilting motion.
